## Summary

The issue was that a core Python module `_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py` was missing from the Python environment. This module is auto-generated during Python's build process and is essential for Python's `sysconfig` module to work properly.

### Root Cause
The file had been renamed to `_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py.bak_7f3a9d`, leaving only backup files (`.bak_7f3a9d` and `.orig`) in place. This caused Python's `sysconfig.get_path()` function to fail when trying to import the module, which cascaded into failures for all Scrapy tests that rely on module imports.

### Fix

```bash
cp /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py.orig \
   /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/_sysconfigdata__linux_x86_64-linux-gnu.py
```
